transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I’ve been thinking a lot about whether my family would be better off if I just weren’t here anymore. My sister and my pastor both got so worried about me that they urged me to come in and talk to someone.
When you feel this depressed, have you ever heard voices or seen things other people couldn’t, or felt certain of things like being punished or watched even when others said it wasn’t true?

No, I’ve never heard any voices or seen things that weren't really there. I also haven't ever felt like I was being watched or punished in that kind of way, either. It's just been a very heavy, dark feeling inside my own head.

Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks? Or did these feelings start mainly after a specific stressful event or major life change?

No, I’ve never felt anything like this before in my life. It all started about nine months ago when my husband's health declined and the stress of his caregiving pushed me into a frantic overdrive, which eventually led to this awful crash. Since that crash, this heavy, hopeless feeling has just completely taken over.

Since this started, have you been depressed most of the day nearly every day and lost interest in almost everything, to the point that you can barely function? Or do the feelings mainly come up when you’re overwhelmed by your husband’s illness and caregiving stress?

Yes, this heavy, hopeless feeling is there nearly every single day, and I've completely lost interest in my quilting and my garden. It's gotten so bad that I can barely function anymore; I've had to cancel all my quilting orders and rely on my sister and church friends to manage my husband's appointments and our bills.

Psychotic symptoms were explicitly denied. Although the episode began in the context of caregiving stress, the syndrome has become pervasive and severe rather than limited to stress-related distress, supporting a severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms.
